bead.title: Tune hybrid async deferred flush chunk for 100k ack p99
bead.description: The bounded-flush fix proved partial draining, but the default 2,000-command chunk still drains the whole 100k release backlog (hundreds of batched commands) under the composed backend mutex and leaves ack p99 failing. Tune or configure the production/test default so deferred SQLite checkpoint work is sliced small enough to protect push ack p99 while preserving bounded debt and exact-once recovery. In scope: default chunk sizing/config seam, docs/evidence notes, tests/perf evidence. Out of scope: weakening the <=1.20 hot-path gate.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-server --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_deferred_flush_chunking -- --nocapture` passes and asserts the default flush chunk is below the 100k release suite command backlog size.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_async_apply_exactly_once -- --nocapture` passes.
3. `PQUEUE_LEDGER_DIR=docs/perf/evidence/hybrid-scale PQUEUE_PERF_ENV=1 PQUEUE_HYBRID_RESIDENT=100000 cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_release_10m -- --ignored --nocapture` passes with bars_met=true.
4. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
